name: Default
description: General-purpose transformation presets for the Pipeline Wizard.
author: SupremeDiffusion

aging.label: Stage 1 — Young Adult
aging.prompt: youthful appearance, smooth skin, bright eyes, full hair

aging.label: Stage 2 — Middle Aged
aging.prompt: visible aging, slight wrinkles around eyes, hair thinning slightly, mature look

aging.label: Stage 3 — Elderly
aging.prompt: heavily aged, deep wrinkles, grey hair, weathered skin, tired eyes

aging.label: Stage 4 — Very Old
aging.prompt: extremely aged, paper-thin wrinkled skin, white sparse hair, sunken features, frail posture

emotion_shift.label: Stage 1 — Neutral
emotion_shift.prompt: neutral calm expression, relaxed face, natural posture

emotion_shift.label: Stage 2 — Uneasy
emotion_shift.prompt: slightly uneasy expression, tension in shoulders, brow furrowed

emotion_shift.label: Stage 3 — Distressed
emotion_shift.prompt: visibly distressed, tears forming, hands clenched, body tense

emotion_shift.label: Stage 4 — Extreme
emotion_shift.prompt: extreme emotion, face contorted, body language dramatic, tears streaming

costume_change.label: Stage 1 — Casual
costume_change.prompt: wearing casual everyday clothes, relaxed look

costume_change.label: Stage 2 — Semi-Formal
costume_change.prompt: changed into semi-formal attire, buttoned shirt, neat appearance

costume_change.label: Stage 3 — Formal
costume_change.prompt: wearing formal elegant attire, suit or gown, polished appearance

costume_change.label: Stage 4 — Theatrical
costume_change.prompt: wearing elaborate theatrical costume, ornate details, dramatic look

weather_shift.label: Stage 1 — Clear
weather_shift.prompt: clear sky, bright natural lighting, warm tones

weather_shift.label: Stage 2 — Overcast
weather_shift.prompt: overcast sky, diffused grey light, muted colors, clouds building

weather_shift.label: Stage 3 — Storm
weather_shift.prompt: dark storm clouds, rain falling, dramatic lightning in distance, wind blowing

weather_shift.label: Stage 4 — Aftermath
weather_shift.prompt: storm clearing, wet surfaces reflecting light, rainbow faintly visible, aftermath debris

damage_decay.label: Stage 1 — Pristine
damage_decay.prompt: clean pristine environment, everything intact and well-maintained

damage_decay.label: Stage 2 — Worn
damage_decay.prompt: slightly worn, paint peeling, dust collecting, minor cracks visible

damage_decay.label: Stage 3 — Damaged
damage_decay.prompt: significant damage, broken windows, crumbling walls, debris on floor

damage_decay.label: Stage 4 — Ruined
damage_decay.prompt: completely ruined, collapsed ceiling, overgrown with vines, abandoned and destroyed

aging.label: Peaceful End
aging.prompt: peacefully resting, eyes closed, serene expression, warm golden light

aging.label: Final Breath
aging.prompt: taking a final labored breath, hand reaching out, fading light

emotion_shift.label: Breakdown
emotion_shift.prompt: complete emotional breakdown, collapsed on the floor, sobbing uncontrollably

emotion_shift.label: Catharsis
emotion_shift.prompt: moment of catharsis, wiping tears, faint smile breaking through, relief visible

costume_change.label: Reveal
costume_change.prompt: dramatic reveal, spotlight hitting the final outfit, confident pose, audience reaction

costume_change.label: Unmasked
costume_change.prompt: removing the costume piece by piece, returning to bare appearance, shedding the persona

weather_shift.label: Lightning Strike
weather_shift.prompt: massive lightning bolt strikes nearby, blinding flash, deafening crack, sparks flying

weather_shift.label: Calm After Storm
weather_shift.prompt: sun breaking through clouds, steam rising from wet ground, peaceful stillness

damage_decay.label: Collapse
damage_decay.prompt: structure finally collapses, cloud of dust and debris, crashing sounds, destruction complete

damage_decay.label: Nature Reclaims
damage_decay.prompt: nature fully reclaiming the ruins, flowers growing through cracks, trees through windows, beautiful decay
